notes.title: Cosmolace is Now Officially Released!
notes.content: [p]We're excited to announce that our puzzle game [b]Cosmolace[/b] is officially out now![/p][p]In this game that blends optical illusion puzzles and emotional storytelling, you play as the Weaver of the universe,[/p][p]using [b]one-stroke drawing[/b] to restore cosmic order while listening to the dreams and laments of the stars.[/p][p]What began as a prototype about "3D one-stroke puzzles" has now evolved into a full experience.[/p][p]This game is both an experiment and an exploration.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who followed us, tried our game, and gave us valuable feedback during development.[/p][p]If you enjoy puzzles, surreal atmospheres, or immersive narrative worlds, we invite you to give Cosmolace a try.[/p][p][/p][p][i]💬 Feel free to share your experience or feedback with us in the community! We’ll continue to listen and improve![/i][/p]

notes.title: Cosmolace will officially launch on July 8!
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce that [i]Cosmolace[/i] will be officially released on [b]July 8, 2025[/b].[/p][p]This is a perspective-based puzzle game built around a unique [b]3D one-stroke drawing[/b] mechanic. Players must find the correct viewpoint in 3D space to connect broken paths and gradually restore the structure of the universe. With a minimalist art style, the game focuses on core gameplay and features a wide variety of levels with increasing difficulty—perfect for puzzle and challenge lovers.[/p][p]🎮 [b]Demo Available Now[/b][/p][p]You can try the early stages of the game right now through the Steam page. Feedback is very welcome![/p][p]Thank you for your support—feel free to play, comment, and share![/p]

notes.title: Cosmolace Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello! I'm Cyoltose, the developer of Cosmolace.

This is a puzzle game that combines perspective illusion, one-stroke drawing, and spatial logic.
You'll solve each level by shifting your viewpoint and connecting the structure in a single stroke — through space and illusion.

Today, [b]the playable Demo is officially released[/b]!

💠 You're warmly invited to try it out and share your thoughts or feedback.
If you enjoy it, don't forget to add Cosmolace to your Wishlist or leave a comment in the community.

Thank you for joining the thread of the universe.
